text: Sinclair Lewis's Elmer Gantry met resistance in 1927, when the North Dakota State Library decided not to stock it. In Boston, sales of the novel could be prosecuted under a law prohibiting indecent and obscene books.
meta_description: Elmer Gantry by Sinclair Lewis: the North Dakota State Library decided not to stock it in 1927; in Boston its sale could be prosecuted.
